parameters.help_en:
The list of components. The components are arranged from bottom to top in the order of the elements.

If you add a component to the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848030.html operation, check the value of the ComponentId parameter returned in the response.

This parameter is required and valid only when the resource type is Component.
This parameter is optional when the resource type is Resource. If you specify this parameter, the component is bound to the video source and switched synchronously.

N indicates the sequence number of the component ID. For example, ComponentId.1 specifies the first component ID, and ComponentId.2 specifies the second component ID
parameters.help_zh:
组件列表。按照元素顺序由下而上排列。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848030.html添加导播台组件，请查看AddCasterComponent接口调用返回的参数ComponentId值。

当资源类型为Component时，参数有用且必传。
当资源类型为Resource时，参数非必传，传入时表示组件与视频源绑定并同步切换。

N表示第几个组件ID。例如：ComponentId.1表示传入第一个组件ID；ComponentId.2表示传入第2个组件ID
parameters.name: component_id

parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, check the value of the CasterId parameter returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, choose ApsaraVideo Live Console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio to view the ID.

The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page of the ApsaraVideo Live console is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台> 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
         
Resource: video source. If you select the Resource type, you must also specify the Settings for the ResourceId and SwitchType request parameter.
Component: component
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型。 取值：
         
Resource：视频源。如果选择Resource类型，必须同时设置请求参数ResourceId和SwitchType。
Component：组件。
parameters.name: episode_type

parameters.help_en:
The video source ID. 
<notice>This parameter is required and valid only when the EpisodeType parameter is set to Resource.
</notice>      
If you add a video source to the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848020.html operation, check the value of the ResourceId parameter returned in the response
parameters.help_zh:
视频源ID。 
<notice>当EpisodeType（节点类型）设为Resource时本参数有用且必传。
</notice>      
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848020.html添加导播台视频源，请查看AddCasterVideoResourcer接口调用返回的参数ResourceId值
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The switching policy. Valid values: 
<notice>This parameter is valid only when the EpisodeType parameter is set to Resource.
</notice>
         
TimeFirst: time first.
ContentFirst: content first.

For more information about video sources, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66094.html
parameters.help_zh:
切换策略。取值： 
<notice>当EpisodeType（节点类型）设为Resource时本参数才有效。
</notice>
         
TimeFirst：时间优先 。
ContentFirst：内容优先。

更多关于视频源的信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66094.html
parameters.name: switch_type

EpisodeId.description_en: The episode ID. You can use this ID as a request parameter to query the episode list of the production studio, modify the episode, or delete the episode
EpisodeId.description_zh: 节目ID。可作为查询导播台节目单、修改导播台节目、删除导播台节目的请求参数
